name: 3D Resources Limited
summary: 3D Resources Limited engages in the exploration of mineral properties in Australia. The company explores for gold, copper, lead, zinc, and nickel properties. It holds interests in projects located in the Proterozoic of the East Kimberley, and the Archaean Cosmo Newbery area, in the Eastern Goldfields, Western Australia. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
